name: Corna del patto
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an ORIGINAL wide 16:9 full-page painterly anime fantasy Oculum background. PRIMARY SCENE: A LUNAR-ALLIED black castle in the Diabolical realm, red CRESCENT EMBLEM carved on its gate, warm protected homes at the base, glaciers on one side and volcanic land on the other. Devils are mostly lunar allies, depict a watchful protective guard, not evil worship. NO Moon body in the sky. Composition: illustrate the whole page naturally, with a quiet darker centre for readable controls, no empty rectangular panels. Matte hand-painted gouache and restrained anime fantasy linework, attractive deliberate shapes, believable construction and materials, detailed but uncluttered, no glossy 3D. The first reference is ONLY for painterly technique; do NOT copy its objects, geography, sunset or lighting. No sun disc, no eye in the sky. Lunar lore: the Moon was good, is now dead and absent from the sky. Lunar and star symbols are allied and protective. Most devils are lunar allies. Use lunar symbols only as physical carvings or relics. No coins, no currency discs, no Obser, no engraved eyes as generic decorations. Any clouds present naturally in the scene mix luminous BLUE dominant, then INDIGO, VIOLET and PASTEL PINK. Do not force clouds indoors. Tell the story ONLY through image details. NO writing, text, UI, logos, watermarks. Do not repeat the previous theme's composition, relic or environment.
